sahneler.metin: In British Columbia, a mountainside collapsed onto a highway.
In seconds, rock buried the road, and four people were killed.
A small avalanche had already stopped cars there.
Two small earthquakes were recorded that morning.
Then Johnson Peak's slope gave way.
Tens of millions of cubic metres of rock came down.
It is one of Canada's largest recorded landslides.
The new highway was built over the debris.

aciklama:
Hope Slide buried a highway under rock. The cause: a massive rock slope failure, possibly linked to small earthquakes.
